title: Baicalin inhibits macrophage glycolysis and succinate-driven HIF-1alpha signaling by targeting PKM2 to alleviate RSV-induced inflammation.
authors: Yang, He; Gu, Yaqian; Dong, Yingying; Sun, Huan; Liufu, Shuangshuang; Xu, Haiyan; Du, Ke; Peng, Linxiu; Xu, Weichen; Lin, Lili; Xie, Tong; Shan, Jinjun; Zhao, Xia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芩苷通过靶向PKM2调节巨噬细胞糖代谢缓解RSV炎症，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection triggers excessive inflammation, contributing to disease severity. Baicalin exerts therapeutic effects against RSV infection by inhibiting viral replication and alleviating inflammation. However, the mechanisms underlying its immunoregulatory during RSV infection remain unclear. Here we found that baicalin alleviated RSV induced inflammation by regulating the macrophage immunometabolism. To investigate metabolic modulation, metabolomic analysis was performed, revealing an obvious reversal in the metabolic profile by baicalin administration. Further metabolic flux analysis using isotope tracers demonstrated that baicalin suppressed the accumulation of lactate and succinate induced by RSV infection. Mechanistically, baicalin inhibited glycolytic metabolism and succinate driven hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha (HIF-1alpha) signaling during RSV infection, thereby suppressing NLR family, pyrin domain containing protein 3 (NLRP3) activation and reducing IL-1beta release. The effects were validated in vitro using a glycolysis activator to confirm the suppression of glycolytic metabolism, and through co-treatment with dimethylsuccinate and RSV to verify the involvement of HIF-1alpha-mediated hypoxia pathway. Final targeting for baicalin at pyruvate kinase M2 (PKM2) was confirmed via molecular docking and limited proteolysis-coupled mass spectrometry. Taken together, these data elucidate a mechanism of baicalin through regulatory immunometabolism of macrophage to alleviate RSV-induced inflammation, which have critical roles in the treatment of RSV infection.
abstract_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）感染引发过度炎症，导致疾病严重程度增加。黄芩苷通过抑制病毒复制和减轻炎症，对RSV感染发挥治疗作用。然而，其在RSV感染期间免疫调节的潜在机制仍不清楚。本研究发现，黄芩苷通过调节巨噬细胞免疫代谢（immunometabolism）减轻RSV诱导的炎症。为探究代谢调节，进行了代谢组学分析，结果显示黄芩苷给药显著逆转了代谢谱。进一步使用同位素示踪剂的代谢流分析表明，黄芩苷抑制了RSV感染诱导的乳酸和琥珀酸积累。机制上，黄芩苷在RSV感染期间抑制糖酵解代谢和琥珀酸驱动的缺氧诱导因子1α（HIF-1alpha）信号通路，从而抑制NLR家族含吡啉结构域蛋白3（NLRP3）激活并减少IL-1β释放。这些效应在体外通过使用糖酵解激活剂验证了糖酵解代谢的抑制，并通过与二甲基琥珀酸和RSV共处理确认了HIF-1alpha介导的缺氧通路参与。最终，通过分子对接和有限蛋白水解偶联质谱法确认了黄芩苷靶向丙酮酸激酶M2（PKM2）。综上，这些数据阐明了黄芩苷通过调节巨噬细胞免疫代谢减轻RSV诱导炎症的机制，这在RSV感染治疗中具有关键作用。
